properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use a transparent dynamic baseline with validated detection properties and explicit rebaseline/change-control rules.
properties.property_name: Adapt monitoring to autocorrelation, seasonality, drift and nonstationarity

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Show both relevant strata and an explicitly weighted aggregate; freeze/justify weighting and monitor composition.
properties.property_name: Stratify mixtures, high-mix/low-volume and changing populations before aggregation

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Adopt only after showing incremental decision value over a cheap baseline, with interpretable follow-up and recalibration rules.
properties.property_name: Use context-adapted multivariate, rare-event, short-run or change-point monitoring only when its added discrimination pays

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use the cheapest design that either represents the target or honestly limits the claim; retain all attempted-unit provenance.
properties.property_name: Design sampling to represent the decision population and selection process

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: A domain-specific decision procedure with transparent OC/risk—not a universal quality property.
properties.property_name: Use acceptance sampling only for bounded lot-disposition decisions where inspection cost or destruction justifies it

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use sampling for the decision it can make; do not infer control, capability or cause from acceptance alone.
properties.property_name: Do not use acceptance sampling as a substitute for process understanding, prevention or improvement

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Plan for the independent information needed to discriminate the decision, update only under a valid sequential/adaptive protocol.
properties.property_name: Size samples around effect/precision, dependence and decision loss—not a universal count

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: No experiment begins as “run a test”; it begins with the decision it can change and the cheapest evidence that discriminates it.
properties.property_name: Frame experiments around an explicit engineering decision, estimand and rival alternatives

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Randomise when it materially reduces causal ambiguity; preserve assignment integrity and analyse the design actually run.
properties.property_name: Use randomisation to protect causal comparisons against assignment bias and support valid error assessment

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Block what is known and costly, randomise what remains, and report context interactions rather than only an adjusted average.
properties.property_name: Block or stratify known nuisance variation without erasing interactions

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Count independent decision-relevant units, disclose dependence, and stop treating correlated reruns as corroboration.
properties.property_name: Require independent replication at the experimental-unit level; treat technical repeats as measurement information

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use factorial structure when interaction ambiguity is decision-relevant; confirm in the intended operating region.
properties.property_name: Use factorial structure to discover interactions and avoid one-factor-at-a-time ambiguity

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Treat screening results as provisional, report aliases, and resolve any ambiguity that could change the decision.
properties.property_name: Use fractional factorial/screening designs only with explicit alias and sparsity assumptions

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Iterate models as provisional maps; require confirmation in the intended context and robustness around the selected point.
properties.property_name: Use response surfaces and iterative experimentation as local learning, with confirmation and boundary discipline

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Show effect, uncertainty, smallest consequential magnitude, and decision; reserve “equivalent” for designs that test a justified margin.
properties.property_name: Report effect magnitude, uncertainty and engineering significance; use equivalence/noninferiority when “no important difference” is the decision

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Protect the claim-generating opportunity set, not merely the final table; use fresh confirmation when adaptivity is complex.
properties.property_name: Control multiplicity, analyst degrees of freedom and selective inference across the actual family of opportunities

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Another observation is justified only when it is expected to change the decision and the stopping/error framework remains valid.
properties.property_name: Plan sequential evidence and stopping so repeated looks do not manufacture confidence

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: State the local causal estimand and separately justify transport; design around interference/order when materially plausible.
properties.property_name: Bound causal claims by external validity, interference, carryover and order effects

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Challenge the assumptions capable of changing the decision; do not confuse robust-to-one-model feature with universal validity.
properties.property_name: Use robustness and sensitivity analysis to expose dependence on model, confounding and nuisance assumptions

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Ask whether the next observation is independently informative enough to change action; choose the cheapest valid discriminator.
properties.property_name: Choose experiments and measurements by expected information or decision value relative to cost

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: First ask whether the decision is already logically or physically discriminated; if yes, stop statistical collection and document the decisive evidence.
properties.property_name: Give precedence to an authoritative deterministic discriminator when it settles the decision

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Test and optimise decision-relevant performance across plausible nuisance contexts, with transparent loss and confirmation.
properties.property_name: Design robustness to nuisance factors and context variation, not only nominal mean performance

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Make reliability conditional on mission, time/exposure, failure definition and context; report bounds and model sensitivity.
properties.property_name: Model reliability over time with explicit failure definitions, exposure, censoring and degradation

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Acceleration is an assumption-heavy bridge whose physical continuity must be evidenced, not a shortcut to certainty.
properties.property_name: Use accelerated testing only with validated stress-to-use mechanisms and explicit extrapolation uncertainty

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Attribute change to documented fixes only when comparable exposure and fresh validation support it; otherwise call it an observed trend.
properties.property_name: Treat reliability growth as intervention-conditioned evidence, not an automatically improving trend

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Report the strongest upper bound supported by independent representative exposure and state what remains unobserved.
properties.property_name: Translate zero observed failures into an upper risk bound, never “perfect reliability”

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Separate central performance from tail claims; calibrate claim strength to observed/validated tail information and consequence.
properties.property_name: Treat rare-event and tail claims as distinct, data-hungry and model-sensitive

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: A held-out score is local evidence; deployment claims require context coverage, shift sensitivity and evaluator integrity.
properties.property_name: Test distribution shift and stress contexts; do not equate held-out performance with deployment validity

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Make one claim per dimension and combine them only through a transparent consequence model.
properties.property_name: Keep mean performance, variability, tail behaviour, reliability over time and model robustness as separate claims

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use metrics as defeasible sensors: preserve an independent construct/outcome path and investigate divergence under optimisation.
properties.property_name: Treat optimised metrics as vulnerable proxies and monitor for gaming/surrogation

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Change only on independent evidence that the measurement/construct—not merely the candidate—is defective or context has legitimately changed.
properties.property_name: Require independent, prospective justification before changing an evaluator, fixture, expected answer or threshold after failure

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Hold one side fixed while testing the other against independent references; leave unresolved when evidence cannot distinguish.
properties.property_name: Separate candidate/process variation from evaluator/measurement variation before assigning corrective action

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: State what was reused, what was protected, and what evidence is genuinely fresh; use independent confirmation for final claims.
properties.property_name: Protect holdouts, reproduce analyses and prevent adaptive evaluation reuse from masquerading as fresh evidence

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use the simplest adequate model and report which guarantees are conditional; switch/robustify when a departure changes the decision.
properties.property_name: Check model adequacy and misspecification against the decision, not through ritual assumption tests

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: A problem-structuring and integration property: right evidence, right order, right scale, with assumptions and consumer decisions explicit.
properties.property_name: Integrate multiple statistical and engineering methods into a system-level evidence strategy

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Every recurring control has a current decision, validity evidence and proportional cost; otherwise simplify, replace, revalidate or retire with risk sign-off.
properties.property_name: Make measurement and controls economically proportional; retire, revalidate or recalibrate stale controls

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use error thresholds only when tied to a declared family, effect/decision and consequence; otherwise report continuous evidence and uncertainty.
properties.property_name: Universal p < 0.05 threshold as an engineering decision rule

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Monitor only where the stream, signal, cost and response are defensible; otherwise choose a cheaper direct/qualitative method.
properties.property_name: Control-chart-everything and automatic run-rule escalation

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Set targets from customer/safety/economic consequences and observed/modelled risk, not brand numerology.
properties.property_name: Universal 3.4 DPMO or “six-sigma level” as the definition of quality

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Retain evidence dependencies and governance where useful; strip mandatory branding and tailor path to problem risk/uncertainty.
properties.property_name: DMAIC/DMADV phase names and tollgates as a general statistical property

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use role/competence systems proportionate to need and assess actual decisions/work products; no required belt taxonomy.
properties.property_name: Belt hierarchy and certification as a general engineering property

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Another observation earns weight only through identifiable independent/conditional information and positive decision value.
properties.property_name: More samples, more reruns or repeated green tests automatically mean more truth

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Use the smallest diagnostic/MSA design that can falsify decision adequacy.
properties.property_name: Mandatory normality tests, fixed gauge R&R cutoffs and full MSA paperwork for every metric

properties.mature_or_evolved_form: Model the actual mean, variance, tails and noise-factor interactions; use a Taguchi criterion only when demonstrably appropriate.
properties.property_name: Universal Taguchi signal-to-noise ratios and orthogonal-array recipes as the definition of robust design

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Compilation, unsafe and FFI boundaries require separate correspondence evidence.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: The bounded principle transfers across type systems; exact guarantees are language-specific.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Currentness controls can strongly protect correspondence, though they cannot establish semantic adequacy alone.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Stale-evidence retirement transfers to every persistent formal artefact.
